title: Single finite evaluation of the directed coefficient-system refinement
statement: Fix finite-field data D,C,E, m≥0, normalized finite operations F at exponent m+1, IsUnit(C.l:D.k), simultaneous operations o and their canonical realization z, separated finite-type quasi-compact f:X→Y, compactifications c,d and refinement r:c→d. Let M be an arbitrary coefficient system on X and K a finite bounded constructible object at exponent m+1, with an isomorphism e from the mth evaluation of M to K. Evaluate systemComparison(r,M), then use supportEvaluation for c and finite support of e. This equals supportEvaluation for d followed by finite support of e, the inverse F finite-support realization for d, the inverse finite compactification comparison F.comparison(f,c,d) at K, and the F finite-support realization for c. Only one finite evaluation is computed; no integral input, system normalization, support reconstruction or equality detection is asserted.

proof.text: Choose a bounded constructible etale origin of K by finiteRing_constructibleDerived_origin. Naturality removes the retained witness, yielding the fixed-scalar support-refinement square.

proof.text: Pass the proper/open-factor square and the direct-compositor square to fixed coordinates using the inverse coefficient equivalence and its unit. Naturality of direct coordinates pastes them; naturality of the fixed compositor moves the open coordinate through it. This proves the system-to-fixed finite refinement square.

proof.text: Transport both support coordinates along e by naturality and use naturality of the finite comparison. Combine the resulting square with the support-refinement square from the first step. Cancel the right support coordinate isomorphism and the finiteSupport isomorphism for d to obtain exactly the stated equation.

theorem systemRefinementFiniteCoordinates
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (m : ℕ)
    (F : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m))
    (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k)) (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o)
    {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f.hom.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f.hom.left] [QuasiCompact f.hom.left]
    (c d : Compactification f.hom.left) (r : c.Refinement d)
    (M : System C.l E X.obj.left)
    (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) X)
    (e : (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation C.l E X.obj.left m).obj M ≅ K.obj) :
    (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation C.l E Y.obj.left m).map
        (RefinementProjection.systemComparison C.l E D o z r M) ≫
      (supportEvaluation C.l E o c m).hom.app M ≫
      (sixFunctorFiniteSupport D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) f c).map e.hom =
    (supportEvaluation C.l E o d m).hom.app M ≫
      (sixFunctorFiniteSupport D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) f d).map e.hom ≫
      (F.finiteSupport f d).inv.app K ≫
      ((F.finite.comparison f c d).inv.app K).hom ≫
      (F.finiteSupport f c).hom.app K
